tweet: imaji v0.2.0: your Mind now renders a 10-second film for every release, not just the card. Tag a release, get the kit. No prompts, no content calendar.
thread: v0.2.0 is out. What changed: the film. Every release now gets a 10-second launch video rendered from HTML, on brand, deterministic, no diffusion model guessing at your logo.
How it works: you tag a release, a GitHub Action wakes your own Mind, the Mind reads the notes, remembers your last release, writes the copy and calls imaji to render the visuals.
Building on v0.1.0, which shipped the card and the private kit page. Next: the Bazaar listing so any Mind can take the job. imaji.s0nderlabs.xyz
linkedin:
We shipped imaji v0.2.0.

Every release your team tags now comes back as a full launch kit: a tweet, a thread, this post, a social card and a 10-second film. Your own Mind writes it, remembering every release before it. imaji only renders.

For solo builders who only ship.
